package.name: cix_ros_dmabuf
package.description: Cross-process dmabuf zero-copy transport for ROS 2. Provides the cix_ros_dmabuf_broker (UDS + SCM_RIGHTS fd relay), C++ BrokerClient / DmaBuffer headers, and the matching Python client, so any publisher or subscriber of sensor_msgs/Image can move pixels as dmabuf fds instead of copying them through DDS. See the ";dmabuf_handle=N" encoding convention documented in README.md.
